verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only building blocks that a CI test setup could use: Gazebo simulation integration, a launch system for bringing up multiple nodes, and rosbag record/play with a Python API for replaying data. Nothing in the pack documents an actual testing framework, CI integration, or simulation-based regression testing workflow. Missing for 10: a documented test framework (e.g. launch-based integration tests), CI/headless execution guidance, an explicit simulation regression-testing workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
